children: Mapp, who purchased the shares in two separate transactions, snapped up the stock at an average price of 121.50p each, for a total value of £25,966.29.
Following the transaction, Mapp holds a beneficial interest in 701,550 ordinary Eurocell shares, representing approximately 0.71% of the company's issued share capital.
As of 1545 BST, Eurocell shares were down 0.81% at 122.50p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
